observations: body L1-L3: «Messahala», «Mā shā’ Allāh», «al–Kindī» and «‘Abd Allāh ibn Masrūr an–Naṣrānī» are letter-spaced; «Abū Ma‘shar» is not. «al–Kindī» and «an–Naṣrānī» have long dashes (5.3 and 5.4 pt). A full stop, not a comma, stands after «libellos» (L1), and a comma after «versus est)».

body L4-L5: the dash after «a)» measures 10.2 pt, the dash between «45» and «pag.» 9.4 pt. Chapter LV begins on p. 131, L45 of the translation, and its first period ends on p. 132, L9 with the sign a.
body L6-L15: the place on the cardines is p. 248; the circle of position is that of p. 311, note 3.

body L16-L18: «al–Battānī» is letter-spaced, with a long dash (5.2 pt); the o of «astronomia» (L16) prints only in part. The place is p. 134, last line of the translation («Has quantitates praesertim cognoscere oportet in nativitatibus, ut significatores dirigantur ad sua loca»), as printed.

body L19-L33: the Greek ἀφίεσθαι, τόπος ἀφετικός, ἀγαϑοδαίμων, ϑεός, τόπος ἀναιρετικός, ἀφέτης and κύριος τῆς ζωῆς are set as printed: the thetas of «ἀγαϑοδαίμων» and «ϑεός» in the open form (ϑ), that of «ἀφίεσθαι» closed; the kappas are printed in the curly form (ϰ). The t of «Ut» (L19) prints broken.
notes_left L1-L4: the end of note 5 begun on p. 312. «Magini», «Delambre» and «Petro Apiano» are letter-spaced.

notes_left L5-L10: «adn» (L5) is printed without a full stop. «65-» and «-66» (L6-L7) and «207-» (L10) have hyphens (3.5, 3.4 and 3.5 pt); the page numbers 65-66 are divided with the hyphen at the end of L6 and repeated at the beginning of L7, as printed.
notes_right L1-L9: the end of note 2. The dash before «Estos» (L3) measures 8.6 pt; «311-12» has a hyphen (3.2 pt). The signature 40 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
